description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Store' class within the admin controller setting namespace for OpenCart, handling various configuration and management actions for store settings including listing, editing, and saving store data.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing store settings, including listing stores, editing store details, and handling form submissions for stores.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that prepares and displays the store management page, including breadcrumbs, store data, and page layout.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles requests for listing all stores with pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of stores with their details.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a store.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to save store data.
